name: Default
shortDescription: Open-source secrets management platform for syncing secrets, certificates and configuration across teams and infrastructure, backed by PostgreSQL and Redis.

alerts.message: The first account that signs up becomes the instance administrator. Create it right after deployment, before sharing the URL.
ENCRYPTION_KEY encrypts every stored secret. Back it up together with the database; losing it makes the data unrecoverable. Email invitations and password resets need SMTP variables added separately.
